content: 把 fg_02_anchor_female.png 抠图放到访谈背景里, 换背景

{"intent": "绿幕人像换到访谈背景(完整光影链)", "nodes": [{"id": "n1", "tool": "T01_matting", "params": {"image": "data/ai_generated/green_fg/fg_02_anchor_female.png"}, "depends_on": []}, {"id": "n2", "tool": "T02_background_generate", "params": {"semantic": "访谈"}, "depends_on": []}, {"id": "n3", "tool": "T03_lighting_estimate", "params": {"bg_path": "$n2.bg_path"}, "depends_on": ["n2"]}, {"id": "n4", "tool": "T04_relight", "params": {"fg_path": "$n1.fg_path", "bg_path": "$n2.bg_path", "light_dir": "$n3.light_dir", "color_temp": "$n3.color_temp"}, "depends_on": ["n1", "n2", "n3"]}, {"id": "n5", "tool": "T05_shadow_generate", "params": {"alpha_path": "$n1.alpha_path", "bg_path": "$n2.bg_path", "light_dir": "$n3.light_dir"}, "depends_on": ["n1", "n2", "n3"]}, {"id": "n6", "tool": "T06_harmonize", "params": {"fg_path": "$n4.relit_fg_path", "alpha_path": "$n1.alpha_path", "bg_path": "$n5.shadow_bg_path"}, "depends_on": ["n4", "n5"]}], "outputs": ["n6"]}
